OWNER DECISION 2026-09-17: the delivered cold review is accepted as sufficient for these three slices. The Fable review is NOT owed any more; this bead closes without it. Recorded as the owner's call, asked and answered explicitly, not as the author's judgement that his own code had been reviewed enough.

WHAT IS BEING ACCEPTED, stated plainly so the record is not flattering:
- The review was run by the DEFAULT MODEL, not Fable 5.1. It was dispatched as a throwaway diagnostic to test whether Fable specifically was down.
- It was COLD -- a fresh-context agent with no memory of writing the code -- and that is the property that made it work. The author had attacked the CorpusProfile digest three times with hand-built forgeries and passed himself every time.
- It covered all three slices owed here: P2b-ii (CorpusProfile/CorpusReader.open), P3 (SegmentLink), P5 (ClockRepair/TimebaseRepair).

WHAT IT FOUND, all fixed and pinned at 287f87d3 and b4ad7d20:
- BLOCKER, in P2b-ii, the slice fable-vet had independently flagged as riskiest: CorpusProfile.identity digested two profiles reading DIFFERENT ARTIFACTS to the same checksum (3880428e). Framing made every part self-delimiting and left the part vector flat and count-free against a variable-arity encodingParts. Fixed by nesting; pinned by the forgery AND by a 150+ member injectivity family, after mutation testing showed the single-forgery probe pinned an instance and not the invariant.
- MAJOR, P3: SegmentLink.of never compared from.work to to.work. Fixed. Cross-axis linking deliberately stays legal and is now pinned as such.
- MAJOR: the Friends receipt reported one sheet's refusals while the profile bound two.
- MAJOR/MINOR: refusalsTruncated was a Boolean; MementoIntake printed no admission line; participantPattern was declared and read by nothing.
- One finding DISPUTED and not applied: refusing a non-monotone Coarsening would refuse Memento, which is cut in reverse. Documented and pinned instead.
- One mutant SURVIVES and is recorded, not hidden: removing the digest nesting while keeping the group tags is injective for today's CellEncoding set. Nesting kept because it does not depend on that property.

WHAT THIS ACCEPTANCE DOES NOT ESTABLISH:
- No Fable 5.1 review of P2b-ii, P3 or P5 was ever performed. Three Fable reviews DID land earlier on this branch (fable-vet plan vet with 4 blockers, fable-p1b on Coded, fable-p2b on P2b-i/P2b-s) but none of them covered these three slices.
- The judgement that the surviving nesting mutant is benign was made by the author and has not been checked by an independent reviewer.
- Cross-language agreement between the Scala and Python gold rules remains unpinned; test_gold_rule_single.py compares Python to Python.

Gate at close: exit 0, 24/24 modules, 2,466 tests, 0 failed, 0 errors, scalafmt clean, 7/7 recall-study tests.
